# TasteIQ

> TasteIQ is an international POS and operations platform for restaurants, cafés, and hotel/property F&B outlets—with OTA channel management for inventory and bookings.

## Product

- **Restaurants & cafés:** billing, KOT, inventory, multi-outlet control, branded ordering, multi-currency, multi-tax (GST, VAT, etc.)
- **Hotels & properties:** multi-outlet F&B, OTA inventory sync, unified booking calendar, rate parity, room service & banquet operations
- **OTA partners:** Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Airbnb, Expedia, Hotels.com, Trip.com, Cleartrip, Yatra, Google Hotels, and more
- **Setup:** AI menu capture; typical go-live ~15 minutes
- **Regions:** India, Middle East/GCC, UK, US, EU, Southeast Asia, and more
